content.text:
Warehouse capacity-limit errors now return 429 instead of 500, and `go test ./...` passes.

The cause was in `errcatalog/warehouse.go`. The `"warehouse.limit"` key was mapped to `api.CodeInternal`, which `HTTPStatus` turns into a 500. Every other domain (ledger, invoice, ingest, export, billing, audit) maps its `.limit` key to `api.CodeQuota`, which gives 429. I changed that one entry to `api.CodeQuota`.

The mapping in `api/errors.go` was already correct, and I left all other mappings alone, including `warehouse.timeout`.

I didn't add a test for this mapping. The `errcatalog` package has none, and I didn't check whether any package under `services/` has tests.
